root_cause.text: In net/sched/cls_api.c, tc_chain_fill_node() constructed a netlink tcmsg from non-zeroed memory but failed to initialize the tcm_info field, causing uninitialized heap data to be exposed to userspace.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE/commit explicitly states “tc_chain_fill_node() never initializes the tcm_info field of struct tcmsg” and “Since the allocation is not zeroed, kernel heap memory is leaked,” and the patch adds the missing initialization line `tcm->tcm_info = 0;` next to the other tcmsg field initializations.
